issue_request: FHIR-43442 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for R6 asking that DocumentReference be analyzed for alignment with the workflow Event pattern and fixed if needed. Its resolution called out updating the mapping so attester aligns with the Event performer pattern.
initial_application: HL7/fhir PR #3712 applied the issue before this reconciliation. Merge commit b046740a9a updated DocumentReference mapping exceptions, and implementation commit 12612628da added workflow mappings for DocumentReference.attester, DocumentReference.attester.mode, and DocumentReference.attester.party in source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml.
additional_context: DocumentReference is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini. The current mapping-exceptions source documents the same Event.performer-family alignment for attester, attester.mode, and attester.party. Later DocumentReference changes did not remove those mappings. Zulip search found no directly relevant discussion; Confluence references only show the broader OO workflow-ticket backlog and no conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source changes were needed because the build-scoped StructureDefinition and mapping-exception source already contain the requested workflow mappings.
